# Skill Shelf

> A lightweight, public registry of reusable AI agent skills. Each skill is a plain Markdown file (SKILL.md) that an AI agent can fetch directly.

## Skills

- [Application Security Review](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/appsec/appsec.md): Structured review of web applications for security flaws.
- [SAST & CI Security Scanning](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/appsec/sast-ci-scanning.md): Build a CI security pipeline — Semgrep (incl. custom taint rules), Gitleaks, Trivy, and Checkov, with severity mapping and reports.
- [Secure Code Review](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/appsec/secure-code-review.md): Remediation-focused review patterns for Python web apps — SQLi, path traversal, RCE, XXE, and XSS with concrete fixes.
- [Hardware Hacking with Arduino](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/hardware/hardware-hacking-arduino.md): Getting started with Arduino and embedded hardware — pins, resistors, serial communication, and blink circuits.
- [Android Pentesting](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/mobile/android-pentesting.md): End-to-end methodology for Android security research.
- [Flutter Mobile Static Analysis](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/mobile/flutter-mobile-static-analysis.md): Authorized, evidence-first static analysis of Flutter/Dart mobile apps using Blutter decompilation or a raw libapp.so.
- [Mobile Hacking Reference (Android)](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/mobile/mobile-hacking.md): Field-tested playbook for analyzing and attacking Android apps, from recon to reporting.
- [Vulnerability Report Writer](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/reporting/vulnerability-report-writer.md): Turns a short vulnerability description into a professional, structured penetration testing finding.
- [API Security Testing](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/web/api-security-testing.md): Practical methodology for finding bugs in web APIs — docs discovery, parameter fuzzing, mass assignment, and server-side parameter pollution.
- [Bug Bounty Recon Playbook](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/web/bug-bounty-recon.md): Automated recon workflow for bug bounty targets — subdomain discovery, live probing, and historic URL harvesting.
- [Web Exploitation Reference](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/web/web-exploitation-reference.md): Quick-reference cheatsheets for web bugs — directory traversal payloads, reverse shells, and CORS exploitation patterns.
- [Web Application Pentesting](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/web/web-pentesting.md): Hands-on web pentesting workflow with evidence capture.
- [Git Release Workflow](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/skills/workflow/git-release-workflow.md): Dependable release process for git projects.

## Machine-readable index

- [Registry](https://DghostNinja.github.io/Skill-Shelf/index.json): Full metadata for every skill.
